items.headline: Sources: Caleb Williams injury considered to have 3-4 week timeline
items.description: Bears quarterback Caleb Williams has a Grade 2 hamstring injury that doctors say could sideline him for three to four weeks, league sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

items.headline: Bears QB Williams out for MNF; backup Bagent back at practice
items.description: Bears QB Caleb Williams is out for Monday's game against the Eagles, and backup Tyson Bagent returned to the practice field while still in the concussion protocol.
